author: IzaakWN
body:
## PR description: This PR updates the TenTau fragments for the workflows for Phase II studies with extended eta, uniform pT. Currently, there are two TenTau workflow fragments in release, uniform in 15 < E < 500 GeV of the generator tau lepton: - `TenTau_E_15_500_pythia8_cfi` up to || < 2.5 - `TenTau_E_15_500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi` || < 3.1 This PR changes the workflows to the following: - `TenTau_E15to500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi` for whomever want to continue using uniform energy. - `TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi` to include full HGCal (|| < 3.1). - `TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta4p1_pythia8_cfi` for pixel-only taus. where the last two are uniform in 10 < pT < 500 GeV and eta. In order to not change the number of existing workflows, which are hardcoded in several places, this PR preserves the position of existing workflows in the `upgradeFragments` list in `upgradeWorkflowComponents.py`. The third workflow is added at the end. See below for the workflow numbers as they appear to `runTheMatrix.py`. See also [this PR to `genproductions`](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-gen/genproductions_cards/-/merge_requests/200) for the upcoming MC campaign. ## PR validation: ### Setup Developed on ```bash export SCRAM_ARCH="el9_amd64_gcc13" scram list CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-08 source /cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/cmsset_default.sh cmsrel CMSSW_20_1_0_pre1 -n CMSSW_20_1_X_wf cd CMSSW_20_1_X_wf/src/ && cmsenv git cms-addpkg Configuration/PyReleaseValidation Configuration/Generator ``` ### Workflow numbers Before the changes: ```python $ runTheMatrix.py --interactive Welcome to the Matrix (? for help) matrix> search TenTau.*Run4D121$ ... 34487.0 TenTau_15_500+Run4D121 34522.0 TenTau_15_500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 Found 2 compatible workflows inside upgrade 34487.0 TenTau_15_500+Run4D121 34522.0 TenTau_15_500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 Found 2 compatible workflows inside cleanedupgrade ... ``` After the changes: ```python $ runTheMatrix.py --interactive Welcome to the Matrix (? for help) matrix> search TenTau.*Run4D121$ ... 34487.0 TenTau_E15to500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 34522.0 TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 34555.0 TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta4p1+Run4D121 Found 3 compatible workflows inside upgrade 34487.0 TenTau_E15to500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 34522.0 TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1+Run4D121 34555.0 TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta4p1+Run4D121 Found 3 compatible workflows inside cleanedupgrade ... ``` ### Workflow physics output Checked the distributions from the new workflows: ```bash runTheMatrix.py -l 34487.0 -w upgrade --nEvents 1000 --nThreads 2 # TenTau_E15to500_Eta3p1 runTheMatrix.py -l 34522.0 -w upgrade --nEvents 1000 --nThreads 2 # TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1 runTheMatrix.py -l 34555.0 -w upgrade --nEvents 1000 --nThreads 2 # TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta4p1 ``` Plot with ```python import os, glob from ROOT import TFile, TH1F, TCanvas, gROOT, gDirectory gROOT.SetBatch(True) def plot(h,d,x): print(h,h.GetEntries()) c = TCanvas('c','c',100,100,900,700) # XYWH h.SetTitle(f"{d} {x};Tau {x};Tau leptons") h.SetLineColor(4) h.SetLineWidth(2) h.Draw('HIST') c.SaveAs(f"{d}_{x}.png") c.Close() for f in glob.glob("/eos/user/i/ineuteli/prod/test3/34*/step1.root"): d = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f)).replace('+',''); print(f,d) with TFile.Open(f,'READ') as F: t = F.Get('Events') t.Draw("recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.pt() >> hp(20,0,600)","abs(recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.pdgId())==15","HIST gOff") t.Draw("recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.energy() >> he(20,0,600)","abs(recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.pdgId())==15","HIST gOff") t.Draw("recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.eta() >> hu(20,-5,5)","abs(recoGenParticles_genParticles__SIM.obj.pdgId())==15","HIST gOff") plot(gDirectory.Get('hp'),d,"pt") plot(gDirectory.Get('he'),d,"energy") plot(gDirectory.Get('hu'),d,"eta") ```
